models.name: Acestep V15 Xl Sft
models.description: ACE-Step v1.5 is a powerful open-source music foundation model that turns a text prompt into a complete song — vocals, lyrics, and instrumentation — at quality that rivals commercial tools. We run the high-quality XL checkpoint with its planning step  ("thinking") on by default, so generations favor musical structure and coherence over raw speed.

prompt.description: Describe the music — genre, mood, instrumentation, vocals, tempo and key — and what you'd like the song to be about.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to sing, with optional [verse]/[chorus] structure tags. Empty means the model writes its own lyrics (or, for instrumental requests, none).

duration.description: Length of the track in seconds (30-500). Leave empty to let the model choose.

response_format.description: Output audio format. mp3 is small and universally playable; flac and wav are lossless.

think.description: Let the planning model arrange structure and phrasing before generation. Higher quality but slower; disable it for faster results.

instrumental.description: Generate instrumental music with no vocals, regardless of lyrics.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output; empty for random.

bpm.description: Target tempo in beats per minute. Empty means the model chooses.

language_code.description: Language for auto-written lyrics. Ignored when you supply lyrics or for instrumental tracks.

negative_prompt.description: Styles, genres, moods, or instruments to steer the song away from — a compositional nudge, not an audio filter. Ignored when the model writes its own lyrics.

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance strength: higher follows the prompt more strictly, lower is more creative/varied. Default 7.

task.description: Generation task. text2music = from text only. cover = restyle a reference track. cover-nofsq = cover without FSQ quantization. repaint = regenerate a region of the input. Every task except text2music requires input_audio.

input_audio.description: The track to transform — used by the cover / cover-nofsq / repaint tasks (set Task first). Leave empty for plain text2music. This is the audio whose structure/melody is reworked, not the style reference below.

reference_audio.description: Optional style reference: the output borrows the sonic character (timbre, production, vibe) of this clip WITHOUT copying its melody or structure. Works with any task, including text2music. Strength is set by Audio Cover / Reference Strength below (lower ≈ looser).

audio_cover_strength.description: How strongly the source/reference audio influences the result — governs both cover (the source track) and reference_audio (the style clip). Lower (~0.2) = looser style transfer; higher (→1.0) = closer to the reference.

flow_edit.description: cover: morph the source toward your prompt/lyrics (an edit), describing the original via flow_edit_source_*.

flow_edit_source_caption.description: flow_edit: caption describing the ORIGINAL input audio.

flow_edit_source_lyrics.description: flow_edit: lyrics of the ORIGINAL input audio.

repaint_start.description: repaint: start of the region to regenerate, seconds.

repaint_end.description: repaint: end of the region to regenerate, seconds (-1 = to the end).

repaint_mode.description: repaint: how much the regenerated region may diverge.

retake_variance.description: Variation amount when re-generating from the same inputs (0 = none).

retake_seed.description: Seed for the retake variation (used only when retake_variance > 0).

audio_codes.description: Advanced: precomputed audio semantic codes for code-controlled generation.
